response.overview: Get On The Floor follows Nia, an ambitious drag performer chasing a dream of becoming successful in Paris, whose desperation to escape poverty leads her and her partner Dee into a disastrous series of events. After a botched robbery leaves them with a dead body, they pursue money through increasingly disasterous circumstances, culminating in a tragic night that forces Nia to confront her ambitions, relationships, and isolation.
response.title: Get On The Floor
